card.name: End of heading or table entry
card.fires_on: The last word or closing bracket of a section heading, table row or dosing line, just before a new section or entry starts, as in 'Based on Renal<< Function>>' or a closing parenthesis after an amount.

modes.label: Heading end
modes.description: Final word of a section or table heading in a drug label.

modes.label: Dose entry end
modes.description: Closing parenthesis, unit or 'daily' ending a dosing table entry or instruction.
modes.example: 6.85 GBq (185 mCi<<)>> Using a shielded syringe, add

modes.label: Drug name in heading
modes.description: Last piece of a drug or product name inside a heading or table title.
modes.example: Drug Interactions With Cisatracurium Besyl<<ate>> Injection In clinical studies, propofol

card.plain: It marks the end of a heading or table line, right before a new section or entry starts.
